note: Cameras for R153's before / after garden-nook previews (render_base_area.mjs of R151). pos / look are world studs (the track runs to +Z; hub floor top y = 4); fov is the vertical field of view; ortho = [centre x, centre z, half width, half height] (+Z up the image, -X to the right). avatars: [x, y (feet), z, yaw, shirt colour] (yaw 1.57 looks towards -X).

views.name: nook_top
views.title: The Lava garden nook from above
views.caption: The plaza at the end of the Lava garden walk, straight down. BEFORE: a flower bed (cream rim, dark soil) in the middle and two teal benches on its edge. AFTER: the benches and the bed are gone; a round trampoline (red frame, ring of gold springs, teal mat, cream badge) stands in the middle with a 7-stud ring of paving all round.

views.name: nook
views.title: The nook from the garden walk
views.caption: From the garden walk. The trampoline is 0.9 studs high over the floor: a player walks onto it like onto a kerb, and each landing or step on it bounces them about 30 studs.

views.name: closeup
views.title: The trampoline up close
views.caption: Six stubby feet, a red frame (a 16-sided ring), 16 gold springs standing in a dark gap, the teal mat and a cream badge, in the hub's own colours.

views.name: bounce
views.title: A bounce
views.caption: The apex of a bounce: the feet rise 30 studs over the mat (a launch speed of 108.5 studs per second under the default gravity) - over the lamps and the trees, still under the 51-stud wall.
